title: API Reference
markdown:
The FastAPI surface lives in `openexecutive.api.main`, which mounts one router per topic. A shared-secret middleware gates every request via an `x-api-key` header, except `/health` and the `/webhook/*` callbacks (which carry their own verification). CORS is restricted to configured UI origins. The gate is off when `BACKEND_SHARED_SECRET` is unset — intended for local development only — so any internet-reachable deployment sets `OE_PUBLIC_DEPLOYMENT`, and `create_app()` then refuses to boot without the secret rather than serving an unauthenticated API.

Endpoints grouped by router:

| Router | Key endpoints | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `chat` | `POST /chat` | SSE stream of a live Executive turn. The request body optionally carries `page_context` (route, page title, guide section id, and a form descriptor with current values) — sent only by the Ask OE side panel so the Executive can explain the current page or propose form values. When the Executive calls its `propose_form_values` tool, the stream emits a `form_patch` event (`{type, form_id, fields, rationale, iteration}`) that the panel applies into the on-screen form as highlighted suggestions; the user reviews and saves through the form's normal submit path. |
| `sessions` | `GET /sessions`, `GET /sessions/{id}/messages` | List and read saved chat sessions. |
| `today` | `GET /today`, `GET /today/activity`, `GET /today/activity/daily` | Morning-brief aggregation, recent-action rail, and Pulse heartbeat heatmap (per-day activity counts). |
| `people` | `GET\|POST\|PATCH /people`, `POST /people/{id}/archive` | Roster CRUD and scope lookups. |
| `departments` | `GET\|POST\|PATCH\|DELETE /departments`, `.../goals` | Department state and per-department goals. `PATCH /departments/{slug}` also takes `watched_entities` (≤50 names, `[]` clears) — the entities the research watch policy may add watches for and route to this department. |
| `agents` | `GET /agents`, `PATCH /agents/{id}`, `POST /agents/{id}/test` | Specialist metadata and Council overrides. |
| `personas` | `GET\|PUT\|POST\|DELETE /personas` | Executive persona definitions. |
| `alerts` | `POST /alerts/{id}/ack`, `POST /alerts/bulk-ack`, `POST /alerts/{id}/reopen`, `POST /alerts/review` | Groom the briefing queue. `ack` (`read`/`ack`/`dismissed`, optional `mute_topic`) also teaches a watch-sourced alert's watch (`trust_score`); `bulk-ack` takes explicit `alert_ids` and/or `older_than_days` + `category` (exempt sources skipped); `reopen` is the Undo for a `resolved` / `expired` / `dismissed` alert (never `ack` or an artifact / decision row; back to `unread` with every review stamp cleared and its TTL anchor refreshed, so it is live again even if older than its TTL); `review` runs the Executive's relevance review on demand (ignores the interval; still honours `ALERT_REVIEW_ENABLED`, the per-pass caps, the single-flight lock and per-alert idempotency) and returns the move counts. `bulk-ack` caps ids at 500, needs `older_than_days >= 1`, and applies watch feedback per row; `mute_topic` must be one of the alert's tags or a scoped `external:` / `department:` pattern. Alerts still surface only through the briefing (`/today` reads the live view) — there is no list, prefs, mutes, or live-stream endpoint. |
| `artifacts` | `GET /artifacts`, `POST /artifacts/{id}/archive` | Browsable research/document artifacts. |
| `decisions` | `GET /decisions`, `POST /decisions/{id}/{approve,reject,cancel}`, `GET /audit/reliability` | Approval-gated decision instances (e.g. calendar bookings). A proposed booking is surfaced on the briefing as a companion alert; approve/reject/cancel here also clear that alert. Reviewed in the briefing — there is no separate proposals page. |
| `audit` | `GET /audit/logs`, `GET /audit/logs/{id}`, `GET /audit/sessions/{id}`, `GET /audit/usage`, `POST /audit/log` | Durable audit trail of side effects. `/audit/sessions/{id}` adds a per-session token cost summary; `/audit/usage` aggregates token usage and OpenRouter cost across all sessions (totals, by day, by model, and by source — the part of the system that made the calls — including server-side web-search counts). |
| `architecture` | `GET /architecture/sections`, `.../sections/{id}` | This documentation surface. |
| `guide` | `GET /guide/sections`, `.../sections/{id}` | Plain-language user-guide content surface — mirrors `architecture` (static, version-controlled files; no LLM on the serving path). |
| `health` | `GET /health`, `GET /health/honcho` | Liveness probes (unauthenticated). |
| `documents` | `POST\|GET\|DELETE /documents`, `GET /documents/{filename}` | Upload, list, view extracted text, and delete indexed company docs. Upload is keyed on the filename, so re-uploading a document replaces its chunks rather than duplicating them, and `DELETE` removes the rows as well as the file. `domain` must be one of the eight specialist domains or `general`; anything else is a 400 rather than a 200 that indexes where no specialist can retrieve. |
| `scheduled` | `GET\|DELETE` scheduled actions (`?status=…&order=asc\|desc`) | Pending and fired scheduled actions; `order` flips the `run_at` sort (asc=soonest-first for the upcoming queue, desc=most-recent-first for terminal-status history). |
| `watchlist` | `GET\|POST\|PATCH\|DELETE /watchlist`, `POST /watchlist/{slug}/approve`, `POST /watchlist/{slug}/decline` | External-monitoring watchlist + signals. Rows carry `origin` (`manual` \| `executive` \| `research` \| `research_proposed`); `approve` turns a research suggestion (`research_proposed`, `dry_run`) into a live watch, `decline` `{reason: not_relevant \| too_noisy \| wrong_source}` removes it and records the decline (or, for `too_noisy`, keeps it live at a high floor), both 409 unless the row is a pending suggestion; `DELETE ?reason=` on a research-origin row records the decline too. |
| `workflows` | `GET /workflows`, `POST /workflows/{name}/runs`, `GET\|POST\|PUT\|DELETE /workflows/custom` | Workflow catalog, run management, and user-created (dynamic) workflow CRUD. |
| `knowledge` | `/knowledge/builtin`, `/external`, `/search` | MBA knowledge base and external sources. `/search` is the introspection parallel of `retriever.retrieve` and mirrors its filters — including the `general` catch-all on the company collection — so the panel cannot report a specialist seeing nothing that it does retrieve in chat. It accepts `general` in `domain_filter` for the same reason. `/search` applies the same review gate as `retrieve()` — withheld (pending or rejected) built-in, external and failure rows are dropped, so the panel never advertises knowledge the Executive cannot use; it degrades to unfiltered rather than failing if review state is unreadable. `POST /knowledge/builtin` refuses a name already held by shipped content, and `POST|DELETE /knowledge/failures` now register and deregister for review — without that a user-authored failure case study had no review row, so no SME decision could block it. |
| `skills` | `/skills`, `/skills/search` | Skill registry CRUD and search. |
| `evals` | `/evals/scenarios`, `/evals/runs` | Eval scenarios and run results. |
| `memories` | `/memories/{decisions,initiatives,advice}` | Episodic-memory record management. |
| `review` | `/review/items`, `/review/stats`, `/review/trusted-defaults`, `POST /review/curate`, `POST /review/bulk-approve` | Knowledge review queue and annotations. Shipped knowledge registers as a trusted default (`approved` with a NULL `reviewed_at`), so the queue starts empty; `curate` (`{domain, action: start|stop}`, domain required) opts one domain in or out, and `trusted-defaults` returns domain → unreviewed count. `bulk-approve` takes a non-empty `domain`, `item_ids` (max 500) or `all_pending: true`, and 400s with no selector; it returns `{approved_count, item_ids}`. |
| `onboarding` | `/onboard/interview/start`, `/onboard/interview/message`, `/onboard/interview/draft`, `/onboard/interview/{id}`, `/onboard/interview/commit` | Conversational company setup. The `onboarding_interviewer` agent asks clarifying questions, then emits a draft profile + people + departments. **Nothing is persisted until `POST /onboard/interview/commit`** — the interview itself never writes. `start` is multipart (description + optional deck/one-pager uploads). |
| `onboarding` (fallback) | `/onboard/start`, `/onboard/answer`, `/onboard/status/{id}` | The original 12-step form wizard, kept as a fallback (UI at `/onboard?mode=form`) and used by the `openexecutive onboard` CLI. |
| `company-profile` | `GET\|PATCH /company-profile` | Structured company profile. |
| `auth` | `GET /auth/allowed-emails` | Allowed sign-in emails. |
| `fixtures` | `/fixtures`, `/fixtures/{name}/load` | Demo-company fixture load/reset/snapshot. |
| `clients` | `/clients`, `/clients/generate`, `/clients/cockpit`, `/clients/save`, `/clients/{slug}/activate` | Client-company slots — multi-client mode for fractional use; create from current/blank/AI-generated intake draft (pasted notes and/or file attachments, multipart on `/clients/generate`), save-back switching, engagement metadata (PATCH), cross-client cockpit, delete. See the Client Companies section. |
| webhooks | `POST /webhook/telegram`, `POST /webhook/google-chat` | Inbound integration callbacks (self-verified). |
| MCP server | `POST\|GET /mcp` | Open Executive exposed as an MCP server (Streamable-HTTP). Not a router — a mounted FastMCP sub-app. Same shared-secret gate (`x-api-key`); exposes company context as resources and the specialist council as tools. See the MCP Server section. |
